name: Deyo Supply Company
old_description: All of the gear and items made to get you through the grit and grime. From headlights to waxed jackets, we have the items needed to get you there.
about:
Deyo Supply Company operates from St. Francisville, Louisiana. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The company presents itself as a curated retailer for the modern outdoorsman.

The company sells outdoor gear, clothing, footwear, and accessories from a roster of established brands such as Choona, Howler Bros, Marsh Wear, Peter Millar, Martin Dingman, Onward Reserve, Duck Head, Genteal, Faherty, GenTeal, Johnnie-O, Criquet, Fenix, Stanley, and Yes Cocktail Co. Product categories include outerwear, footwear, hats, button-down shirts, dress shirts, everyday carry items, and headlamps. The business runs an e-commerce site with free shipping on orders over $75 and maintains a physical presence in St. Francisville.

Deyo Supply targets consumers who move between field and town, serving hunters, anglers, and outdoor enthusiasts. The merchandise spans waterfowl, big-game, and fishing pursuits, as well as casual and refined wear for social occasions. The company does not appear to serve industrial or B2B manufacturing markets.

The brand positions itself around the tagline "Savagely Civilized, Wildly Refined" and the concept "From Duck Blind to Dinner," emphasizing versatility from rugged use to evening wear. This positioning is offered as the company's distinguishing idea.
